notes: Connectors, polished: a Website feed that puts your latest X, Mastodon, DEV, Telegram and LinkedIn posts on your home page with Follow buttons; a new composer with live previews and one-click AI rewrites; an Ollama writer that knows your studio and every app (voice, per-app notes, per-platform style, length, emoji and hashtag controls); automation with per-app filters, per-platform templates and previews; hashtags, sign-offs and UTM tags per platform; rich Discord cards. Also: featured covers are never cropped, and Product Hunt cards for embeds.
